name: icon-agency
description: ICON Agency site — semantic HTML + Tailwind v4 + GSAP, built for Drupal (SDC / Canvas) handoff.

scripts.build:theme: tailwindcss -i drupal/web/themes/custom/icon/src/main.css -o drupal/web/themes/custom/icon/css/main.css --minify && tailwindcss -i drupal/web/themes/custom/icon/src/editor.css -o drupal/web/themes/custom/icon/css/editor.css --minify && node scripts/editor-css.mjs && node scripts/theme-js.mjs
scripts.check: npm run check:php && npm run check:drupal && npm run check:rector && npm run check:js && npm run check:styles && npm run verify
scripts.check:php: cd drupal && if command -v php >/dev/null 2>&1; then scripts/checks/php; else ddev exec scripts/checks/php; fi
scripts.check:php:fix: cd drupal && if command -v php >/dev/null 2>&1; then scripts/checks/php --fix; else ddev exec scripts/checks/php --fix; fi
scripts.check:drupal: cd drupal && if command -v php >/dev/null 2>&1; then scripts/checks/drupal; else ddev exec scripts/checks/drupal; fi
scripts.check:rector: cd drupal && if command -v php >/dev/null 2>&1; then scripts/checks/rector; else ddev exec scripts/checks/rector; fi
scripts.check:rector:fix: cd drupal && if command -v php >/dev/null 2>&1; then vendor/bin/rector process; else ddev exec vendor/bin/rector process; fi
